carrier craft |firstuse= |retired= |affiliation=*[[Royal House of Naboo]] *[[Galactic Republic]]{{Film|II}} }} The '''J-type diplomatic barge''', also called the '''Naboo Royal Cruiser''' or simply the '''Naboo cruiser''',{{SW|url=films/star-wars-episode-2-attack-of-the-clones-story-gallery|text=''Star Wars: Attack of the Clones'' Story Gallery}} was a [[diplomat]]ic [[transport]] used by representatives of the [[planet]] [[Naboo]]. [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] utilized a custom-built cruiser during the [[Separatist Crisis]], which was damaged on [[Coruscant]] in an [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|attempt]] on her life. She later used the J-type during the [[Clone Wars]], when she was targeted by the [[bounty hunter]] [[Aurra Sing]]. ==Description== [[File:JtypeDiplomaticBargeTop-MF55.png|thumb|left|250px|Top view of a J-type barge]] A custom-built [[transport]] constructed by the [[Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps]], the J-type [[Diplomatic barge/Canon|diplomatic barge]] was intended to address the shortcomings of the previous [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship|J-type 327 Nubian starship]], featuring improved [[Deflector shield generator|shield generators]] and paired [[S-6 hyperdrive generator]]s to complement the [[superluminal drive]]. The [[Chromium|chrome]]-plated [[hull]] featured two broad wings each fitted with two engines and recharge sockets for [[starfighter]]s situated along the wings' leading edges, allowing it to carry up to four [[N-1 starfighter]]s. The J-type was unarmed. Although chrome-plated Naboo ships were typically reserved for the [[Monarch of Naboo]], [[Queen]] [[Réillata]] allowed [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] to use one.''[[Star Wars: The Galactic Explorer's Guide]]'' ==Role==
[[File:Naboo_Royal_Cruiser_DB.png|thumb|left|250px|Senator Amidala's J-type barge arrives at Coruscant]]
As a [[diplomatic barge]] used by members of the [[Royal House of Naboo]], the J-type functioned as an unarmed [[transport]] often paired with escort [[starfighter]]s, and its wing-mounted recharge sockets allowed it to be used as a fighter carrier craft. ==History== The J-type diplomatic barge was introduced by the [[Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps]] to improve upon the earlier [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship|J-type 327 Nubian starship]] utilized by the Queen of Naboo. As [[senator]] of the [[Chommell sector]], Padmé Amidala made use of a diplomatic barge to reach [[Coruscant]] for the [[Military Creation Act]] vote in [[22 BBY]]. Escorted by three [[N-1 starfighter]]s, Amidala's royal cruiser touched down on a landing platform only to be completely destroyed by an explosive device planted by the [[Clawdite]] [[assassin]] [[Zam Wesell]]. Amidala's decoy [[Cordé]] and other members of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces]] were [[Death|killed]] in the blast. [[File:J-type_Diplomatic_Barge_TCW.png|thumb|left|250px|Amidala's J-type barge lands on Alderaan.]] After the destruction of her previous barge, Amidala was given another that she continued to make use of across [[the galaxy]] during the course of the [[Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY]] Amidala took her J-type cruiser on a diplomatic mission to [[Council of Neutral Systems|neutral]] world of [[Mandalore]] to guarantee the pacifist planet the full protection of Galactic Republic.{{TCW|Corruption (episode)}} Later that year she and [[Ahsoka Tano]] traveled aboard the ship to [[Alderaan]] to attend a [[Alderaan Refugee Conference|conference]] on the [[refugee]] crisis being caused by the war.{{TCW|Assassin (episode)}} ==Appearances== *''[[Queen's Shadow]]'' {{Ab|Queen's Shadow (audiobook)}} *{{Film|II}} {{1st}} *{{TCW|Corruption (episode)}} *{{TCW|Assassin (episode)}} *{{TCW|Sphere of Influence}} *{{IDWAdventuresCite-2017|issue=12|story=Intermission, Part 1}} *{{TCW|A Friend in Need}} ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'' ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/assassin-concept-art-gallery|text="Assassin" Concept Art Gallery}} *{{SWE|characters|padmeamidala|Padmé Amidala}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|15|Databank A-Z}} *{{SWCT|set=Base Series 1|cardname=Captain Typho -
